description: Generate a properly encoded mailto: link with to, cc, bcc, subject and body — click to test, copy to use in any website or email signature.

faqs.a: mailto: links open the visitor's default email app with the recipient, subject and body pre-filled. Everything after the ? must be percent-encoded, which this tool does for you.
Separate multiple addresses with commas. Both comma and semicolon separators you type are normalized to commas.
Yes — the body is encoded with encodeURIComponent, so newlines, quotes and special characters survive intact.
faqs.q: Does the message body keep line breaks?

faqs.a: Absolutely, everything runs in your browser and nothing is sent anywhere.

howto: Enter the recipient addresses, subject and message body.
